mechanism: Tolterodine is metabolized by CYP2D6 and propranolol inhibits CYP2D6, increasing tolterodine levels; both drugs have anticholinergic and cardiac effects that may be additive.
action: Monitor for increased tolterodine adverse effects (dry mouth, constipation, urinary retention, blurred vision) and cardiac effects; consider dose reduction of tolterodine or alternative antimuscarinic if symptoms emerge.
